name: Curdle
author: E. T. Carter
description: A pale drop falls into dark tea: a bright blob blooms at a hashed position, then its crisp boundary is stretched and folded by accumulating curl-noise warp, winding into high-contrast filament tendrils that coil back into themselves before dissolving to ghost threads on near-black. Two drops run on staggered half-cycle phases so the frame is never empty.

params.label: Drop period
params.effect: Seconds per drop life cycle — short keeps lively overlapping blooms, long lets each drop wind out in near-stillness.

params.label: Fold strength
params.effect: Strength of the accumulated warp — low drops merely wobble and fade, high ones shred into tightly coiled tendrils.

params.label: Drop size
params.effect: CSS-pixel radius of a fresh drop, setting the scale of everything its tendrils become.
